summary: Full backend + smoke frontend test for HBOT Clinic MVP. 31/31 pytest cases pass: auth (all 5 roles via httpOnly cookies), /auth/me, bad-password 401, Google /session endpoint reachable, clinic isolation (DOCTOR sees only demo clinic, SUPER_ADMIN sees all), RBAC (SECRETARY blocked from diagnoses/encounters, allowed on patients/appointments; DOCTOR allowed on diagnoses), patient CRUD with HB-2026-xxxxxx number, timeline, global search, soft delete removes from list and returns 404, dashboard stats returns all 12 KPIs, wound create generates W- code, wound_assessment TIME tissue payload accepted, HBOT plan+session create, safety screening has_risk flag + outcome 'Hekim değerlendirmesi gerekli', lab/imaging/document/consent-with-signature CRUD, anamnesis create+approve (PUT), audit list works and PUT/DELETE/POST on /audit return 404/405 (append-only verified), reference icd + sut rules (versioned) work. Frontend smoke: doctor login lands on dashboard, 6 KPI cards render, patients page shows 5 demo rows, patient detail shows all 12 expected tabs (tab-timeline, anamnesis, encounters, vitals, physexam, safety, wounds, hbot, labs, imaging, documents, consents), timeline populated, no console errors. Anamnesis kiosk wizard at /anamnez/:id renders 'Adım 1 / 9' with correct progress but Step 1 body is blank — see frontend issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Step 1 (Kimlik ve İletişim) renders blank body. Patient fetched via api.get(`/patients/${id}`) which requires STAFF_ROLES. If opened by an unauthenticated patient (kiosk use case) the fetch is swallowed by catch(()=>{}) and the first-step inputs never render. Even for staff the empty catch hides errors silently.

action_items: Kiosk wizard: expose a minimal public (or token-scoped) endpoint to fetch patient first_name/last_name/phone for the identity step, OR gate /anamnez behind auth and surface a login prompt. At minimum, remove the silent catch(()=>{}) and show a toast/error so blank-step state is diagnosable.
CORS: backend/.env has CORS_ORIGINS='*' but server.py uses settings.FRONTEND_URL + localhost explicitly, so the env value is unused. Either read it or drop it from .env to avoid confusion.
Config: core/config.py imports load_dotenv but uses os.environ[...] with no defaults — fine, but ADMIN_PASSWORD fallback 'admin123' in Settings is a code smell (never used in prod but misleading).
critical_code_review_comments: generic CRUD POST uses raw request.json() without Pydantic validation — any field can be inserted; acceptable for MVP but should be constrained for safety-screening/wound-assessment payloads later.
Audit log for SUPER_ADMIN uses clinic_filter which returns {} (sees all) — correct.

/api/anamnesis route is registered via STAFF_ROLES which means patients themselves cannot POST — if wizard is truly kiosk for patients, enforcement does not match the user story. Currently approvals etc. work because staff are posting from the kiosk device.
TIME tissue-sum-to-100 is only enforced in UI per request; backend accepts any sum. OK by spec.
server.py mounts app.add_middleware AFTER include_router. Starlette resolves this fine but conventional order is middleware first; low risk.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_ prefixed patients, diagnoses, wounds, hbot plan/session, lab, imaging, document, consent, anamnesis within the DOCTOR demo clinic. Not cleaned up (soft-delete only tested once).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend baseline is green. Only outstanding item is the kiosk wizard patient fetch (anonymous access vs staff auth). All data-testids present and stable. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses httpOnly cookie session (requests.Session) — reuse the _login helper.
rca of the issue: AnamnesisWizard calls GET /api/patients/{id} which is gated by require_roles(STAFF_ROLES). When wizard is used anonymously as a kiosk (/anamnez/:patientId route is not auth-guarded in the SPA), the request returns 401 and the swallow catch(()=>{}) leaves patient=null, so the identity-step JSX guard `{s.key==='identity' && patient && (...)}` renders nothing. Mitigation: add a lightweight public patient-summary endpoint restricted to id+first_name+last_name+phone, or require staff login before launching the kiosk.
